customManagers.description: Core-tier image pins in DEFAULT_DOCKER_IMAGES (the committed source of truth). Matches the full_image field; a PR bumps the pin, the lockstep tag/full_image are edited together in review.
Bundled Layer 2 catalog template image pins (catalog_templates/*.yaml).

packageRules.description: The Python runtime pins target DSM Python 3.8; do not let Renovate push them past what the NAS runs. Group the pip deps into one PR.
Docker image bumps: reviewed PRs; a core-image bump ships to instances via a release (config.yaml asset), so keep them deliberate.
